Method of Attack: Claimed zero-day exploit in Plone CMS to hack FBI website
Dumped CMS login credentials of over 250 FBI accounts
Posted screenshots showing access to restricted parts of FBI CMS
Fake hack using rudimentary Photoshop skills or Chrome JavaScript developer console
Attempted sale of alleged zero-day on Dark Web for around $9,000
Impacted Systems: EU Agency for Network Information and Security website
Intellectual Property Rights Coordination Center website
Attack Vector: Exploitation of alleged zero-day vulnerability in Plone CMS
Indicators of Compromise: Two PasteBins published by hacker with claimed credentials and technical details
Screenshots posted on Twitter showing access to FBI CMS
Leaked data with email addresses matching publicly available FBI emails
Screenshots showing server logs with Indian Standard Time timezone instead of Eastern Standard Time
Files named acc_102016.bck, acc_112016.bck, old_acc16.bck claimed to be stolen backups
